title: Close obsolete KAIOS warp-index lineage without importing its writable workflow or stale UI

prior_repository_disposition.summary: Repository owner marked PR 202 superseded for integration and instructed that it must not be merged.

reason: PR 202 is an explicitly superseded Draft, is 706 commits behind exact current main, and has been replaced by PR 203 for lineage review. Its workflow adds scheduled and workflow-dispatch execution with actions:write and contents:write, directly pushes generated evidence to main, and dispatches the Pages workflow. Those side effects are outside this automation's merge authority. Its separate warp-index UI and local KAIOS margin engine also predate the current V4.1 shell, current native-market core, authenticated actor model, browser QA, and fail-closed oracle policy. The only safe bounded action is an evidence-only closeout that imports none of the candidate files and closes PR 202 unmerged after this work order reaches exact current main.
